purpose: 检查公开需求中的逐位置还原关系，并覆盖数字和字符串的重复值
cmd:
QT_QPA_PLATFORM=minimal xvfb-run --auto-servernum python - <<'PYCHECK'
import numpy as np
from Orange.widgets.data.owcreateclass import unique_in_order_mapping
for values in ([8, 4, 6, 8, 4], ["zebra", "apple", "zebra", "mint", "apple"]):
    a = np.asarray(values)
    unique, mapping = unique_in_order_mapping(a)
    print("input", a.tolist(), "unique", unique.tolist(), "mapping", mapping.tolist())
    assert np.array_equal(unique[mapping], a), "mapping must reconstruct the input"
PYCHECK
